1.20.1.1.0.3: Performance: fluid pipes, logistics pipes and solar panels are far lighter for the game to load, so it starts much faster and uses less memory. Pipe flanges no longer flicker against the distillery tower. Jetpack no longer draws stray lines over the shoulders and chest. Circuit assembler, alloy smelters, fluid enricher, metal former, ore washing plant, polymerizer and thermal centrifuge now reject invalid items in every input slot instead of bouncing them back. Taking a tension upgrade out of a machine that still holds energy now asks for confirmation, since the lower voltage limit can make it explode.
1.20.1.1.0.2: Update notifications in chat (client toggle). Quarry and forester refuse placement when anything sits where the frame goes; the quarry builds its frame first and mines the inside from the top, and flowers cost no energy. Landmarks only pair with their mutual nearest partner, so neighbouring sets cannot be mixed up. Smoother gantry head animation. Machine input slots reject invalid items on the client. Pump accepts efficiency upgrades. Shared assembly tables craft only the claimed recipe. Request table result slot crafts on every quick click, like the crafting table. JEI/REI recipe pipe import merges inputs, infers tags, keeps returned items stocked, skips chance results and batches brewing recipes.
1.20.1.1.0.1: Faster base quarry, extractor consumes treetaps, instant acid damage, iridium ore light, fix far-from-spawn quarry.
